Nayan starts from point A and drives 5 km towards east. He then takes a right turn and drives 9 km. He takes a final left turn and drives 2 km and stops at point B. Raghav starts from point P, which is 16 km east of point A, and drives 2 km towards west. He then takes a left turn and drives 9 km. He takes a final right turn and drives 6 km and stops at point Q. What is the shortest distance between point Q and point B? (All turns are 90° turns only.)

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.Statements:All sports are beds.Some beds are fans.Some fans are cars.Conclusions:(I) Some cars are sports.(II) Some fans are sports.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.) है।

questions.question: Eight persons are sitting in two parallel rows, containing 4 persons each, in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.In row 1, E, F, G and H are seated and all of them are facing south.In row 2, Q, R, S and T are seated and all of them are facing north.Thus, each person faces another person from the other row. F sits second to the left of H. R sits second to the right of T. Only two people sit between T and Q. E faces S. Which of the following options represents people sitting at extreme ends of the line?3169

A statement is given followed by two courses of action, numbered I and II. You must assume everything in the statement to be true and on the basis of the information given in the statement, decide which of the courses of action logically follow(s) for pursuing.Statement:The environmentally sensitive zones in Country X are being disturbed by the large number of tourists from around the world, leading to pollution and degradation.Courses of action:I. The government has recently revised their immigration policy for those who want to migrate permanently to Country X.II. The government of Country X has launched several initiatives, including banning single-use plastics, restricting public access to eco-sensitive zones, and educating tourists not to pollute the country's environment.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Only II follows) है।

Similarly, a certain mathematical operation on the second number results in the third number and so on. In a certain code language,‘A # B’ means ‘A is the father of B’,‘A $ B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’,‘A ! B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’, and‘A > B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.Which of the given options will make the following statement true?‘P is the father of D’s father’
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (P # Q ! C # D) है।
